contact.basis: Exterior public-street point3m outward from the midpoint of actual long edge5-to6, selected before terrain/geometry; not a surveyed building floor datum.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in fixed native whole Kavanagh Building frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.1m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Coarse urban composite may contain building/canopy artefacts and does not resolve the building foundation or street thresholds. Exact construction-grade classification is unspecified; source field does not certify ground contact.
